newsitem.title: USA: Interdigital adopts holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Interdigital adopts holder rights plan.

text.p: InterDigital Communications Corp said Friday it has adopted a shareholder rights plan and declared a distribution of one right for each common share of record January 3 and for each share issued by the company thereafter prior to the triggering of the rights.
The rights plan was not adopted in response to any offer or proposal from any third party to acquire the company.
The company said the rights, which were adopted with the advice of Merrill Lynch, its investment banker, will trade with the company's common.

The threshold for triggering subsequent distribution of the rights is 10 days following a non-exempt person becoming the owner of 15 percent or more of the then outstanding common shares, or 10 days following commencement of an offer to acquire 15 percent or more of the then outstanding shares.
Beneficial ownership for purposes of the plan generally excludes shares acquired pursuant to company stock-based plans for employees and directors.
The rights will expire at the close of business on the tenth anniversary of the rights agreement unless redeemed by the company, it said.
A majority of independent directors may redeem the rights in whole, but not in part, at a price of $0.01 per right.
